InferDroid milestone 1 native runtime

LiteRT-LM v0.14.0-alpha.0
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/tree/0b98b80e1d846af27d10b8ab395645119cb231e4
Copyright The ODML Authors. Apache License 2.0.
The InferDroid adapter adapts the initialization/conversation sequence from
runtime/engine/litert_lm_main.cc. Changes: a C boundary callable through JNI,
document-descriptor model access, an explicit app native dispatch directory,
a bounded output length, diagnostics, and loaded-library verification.
No patches to the upstream LiteRT-LM runtime sources are applied.

LiteRT
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/tree/43d8b4f20ef743a7c5beb69c365538e726cc20d9
Copyright Google LLC and contributors. Apache License 2.0.
libLiteRtDispatch_GoogleTensor.so is built from the pinned upstream source.

libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.so
Unmodified upstream LiteRT-LM prebuilt/android_arm64 artifact, obtained from
the above LiteRT-LM commit. SHA-256:
985ec5778144730b80666a0f71f1e06038eb07dd1a3e941c6ab7f963eda00a8e
Upstream repository license: Apache License 2.0.
Its implementation is supplied as a binary at this tag, not rebuilt here.

Root upstream licenses accompany this notice. Native dependency license files
available in the source build are collected into generated/LICENSES.txt.
This is a superset including build-only dependencies, not a claim about opaque
third-party internals of the upstream prebuilt constraint provider.

The proprietary device library /vendor/lib64/libedgetpu_litert.so, Tensor SDK
compiler, and Gemma model weights are not included in this APK or repository.
The vendor library is loaded from the physical Pixel through Android's linker.

Build strategy reference:
https://github.com/bejoyfuuul/litert-lm-tensor-g5-npu/tree/8f26b917dcd0dbe04f142f43a7c24f9141136d7f
No executable from that project's release is used as InferDroid's engine.
